# CGPA Helper

> Free academic calculators for CGPA, SGPA, GPA conversion, and percentage calculation.

## Tools

- [CGPA Calculator](https://cgpahelper.com/cgpa-calculator): Calculate CGPA and SGPA with official university grading scales
- [CGPA to GPA Converter](https://cgpahelper.com/cgpa-to-gpa-calculator): Convert between different GPA scales
- [Universal GPA Converter](https://cgpahelper.com/universal-gpa-converter): Course-by-course transcript conversion across global scales
- [CGPA vs SGPA](https://cgpahelper.com/cgpa-vs-sgpa): Understand the difference between CGPA and SGPA
- [ICSE Calculator](https://cgpahelper.com/icse-percentage-calculator): ICSE board percentage calculator

## About

CGPA Helper provides privacy-first academic calculators. All calculations run entirely in the browser — no data is collected or stored.
